description_for_human: Govern Copilot workflow proposals, risk review, approval, release, and audit evidence.
description_for_model: Use Signal Foundry to search approved Copilot capabilities, recommend role-relevant workflow ideas from permission-aware Work IQ summaries, create proposals, score risk, submit review, approve or reject proposals, release approved capabilities, generate release packets, generate capability maps, and list audit-safe MCP activity. Demo default company is Asteria Dynamics with tenantId tenant-asteria-dynamics and projectId revenue-ops-launchpad. Work IQ inputs must be sanitized summaries only, never raw Microsoft 365 content or personal data. Do not use it for employee monitoring or productivity scoring. Never claim a registry write, audit event, or correlation ID exists unless a tool returned ok:true for that operation. Do not use it for weather, news, sports, stock prices, generic web search, unrelated services, or destructive delete, purge, or tamper operations. Refuse out-of-scope requests and redirect to governed Signal Foundry workflows.

functions.name: search_capabilities
functions.description: Search approved or proposed capabilities by role, department, stage, risk, or keyword. Return only sanitized summaries and the actual tool correlationId.

functions.name: recommend_capabilities_for_role
functions.description: Recommend approved and candidate capabilities for a role using synthetic or permission-aware Work IQ summaries only. Demo default company is Asteria Dynamics. Do not include raw emails, chats, documents, transcripts, customer records, PII, or productivity scoring.

functions.name: create_capability_proposal
functions.description: Create a governed proposal from a selected use case. Requires explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Create proposal
confirmation.body: Create a Signal Foundry capability proposal and write an audit event?

functions.name: score_capability_risk
functions.description: Write a deterministic risk review for a proposal. Requires explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Score capability risk
confirmation.body: Create a risk review record for this capability proposal?

functions.name: submit_capability_review
functions.description: Route a scored proposal to a reviewer. Requires explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Submit review
confirmation.body: Submit this proposal to the named reviewer and write an audit event?

functions.name: approve_capability
functions.description: Approve a capability proposal for release. Requires reviewer authorization, explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Approve capability
confirmation.body: Approve this capability proposal as the authenticated reviewer?

functions.name: reject_capability
functions.description: Reject a capability proposal with a reason and next action. Requires reviewer authorization, explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Reject capability
confirmation.body: Reject this capability proposal and record the reason?

functions.name: release_capability
functions.description: Release an approved capability as a reusable playbook. Requires prior approval, explicit user confirmation, confirmed:true, idempotencyKey, and correlationId. Only report success from an ok:true tool result.

confirmation.title: Release capability
confirmation.body: Release this approved capability and create a release packet?

functions.name: generate_release_packet
functions.description: Generate an audit-safe release packet for judges and reviewers.

functions.name: generate_capability_map
functions.description: Return Signal Atlas graph data for roles, signals, risk gates, and workflows.

confirmation.title: Generate capability map
confirmation.body: Generate audit-safe Signal Atlas map data?

functions.name: list_mcp_activity
functions.description: Return audit-safe MCP activity for the Foundry Floor. Use this to verify writes before claiming an audit trail changed.
